nodes.label: Interior Hallway / Entryway – Minimalist Renovation (After)
nodes.description: Completed interior renovation of a hallway/entryway area. Shows minimalist design: white flush-mounted frameless interior doors with black hardware/handles, large-format light grey porcelain tile floor, recessed linear LED ceiling lighting, and a tall full-height wooden wardrobe/storage unit with natural oak finish on the right side. Clean, modern finish-out. After state.

nodes.label: Interior Hallway Corridor – Smart Home Apartment Renovation (After)
nodes.description: Completed interior renovation of an apartment hallway/corridor. Features a flush frameless door in warm beige/greige finish with black lever handle, recessed linear LED ceiling lighting, large-format light stone-effect porcelain tile floor, warm beige painted walls, a wall-mounted smart home tablet/panel on the left wall, and a glimpse into a modern white kitchen with wood-accented lower cabinets in the background right. After state.
nodes.work_type: interior renovation – finish-out with smart home integration

nodes.label: Interior Bedroom – Minimalist Residential Renovation (After)
nodes.description: Completed interior renovation of a bedroom. Shows minimalist Scandinavian-influenced design: warm beige/greige painted walls, engineered wood plank flooring (light oak tone), a white dressing table with drawer and wooden legs, a grey upholstered chair, wall-mounted flat-screen TV, taupe curtains, and a bed partially visible at the bottom edge. Frameless flush door on the left. Clean, finished state. After state.
